thread:
jordan: FYI — Invoice INV-3482 is on hold due to a VAT validation mismatch. Customer PO references Acme Holdings Ltd (parent), vendor submitted resale cert for Acme GmbH (subsidiary). Can billing confirm what we need to clear this?

maria: Thanks Jordan. Do we have the VAT ID the vendor submitted? Any raw response from our validation endpoint?

jordan: Vendor VAT ID: DE123456789. Attached are the agent notes: 'VIES check timed out, local gov portal returned match on name but different legal entity. PO payee = Acme Holdings Ltd (GB), invoice payee = Acme GmbH (DE).'

lukas: Ping me the merchant_id and invoice id. If the PO payee and invoice payee are different legal entities, finance usually needs evidence of intercompany billing or a credit note.

jordan: merchant_id: m_9wY12, invoice: INV-3482, PO: PO-9921. Example API call we made: ```curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/validate_vat -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"vat_id":"DE123456789","country":"DE"}'``` Response we logged: ```{"status":"warning","reason":"name_mismatch","matched_name":"Acme GmbH","provided_name":"Acme Holdings Ltd"}```

billing-bot: Automated note: invoice INV-3482 auto-flagged for manual review (rule: vat_entity_mismatch). Please attach seller's resale certificate + proof of right to invoice (intercompany agreement or PO addendum).

maria: If VIES returned ambiguous/timeout earlier, have we tried the local Bundeszentralamt portal? Sometimes name normalization differs (branch suffix, punctuation).

jordan: We did a secondary check; the portal shows DE123456789 active under 'Acme GmbH', not under the UK parent. Customer insists PO authorizes billing to Acme GmbH though PO header lists the parent company.

katie-cs: Customer (procurement contact) said they can upload a PO amendment to explicitly name Acme GmbH as the payee. Would that satisfy finance/compliance?

compliance-eng: Quick checklist: 1) Resale certificate showing VAT ID and legal name (signed). 2) PO or PO amendment matching the invoice payee legal entity. 3) If payee != contract party, a short intercompany agreement or authorization letter. Without these, reverse-charge/exemption can't be applied.

l u k a s (typo for realism): @compliance-eng any tolerance for matching (e.g., 'Acme GmbH - UK Branch' vs 'Acme Holdings Ltd')? We see small variations a lot.

compliance-eng: We accept exact legal entity or documented affiliation. For ambiguous cases we ask for bank confirmation or a letter on company letterhead tying the VAT ID to the payee. Minor punctuation differences are okay; different legal entities require docs.

maria: Action items: Jordan — ask vendor for: 1) signed resale certificate (PDF), 2) bank statement or supplier letter tying DE123456789 to Acme GmbH, 3) PO amendment or authorization from customer. Once uploaded, tag the ticket and finance will re-run validation.

jordan: Will do. Also flagging a reproducible failure in our VAT check flow: VIES sometimes returns 504 on heavy load. Repro steps below if helpful for infra: 1) curl VIES endpoint with large batch of ids at 9:18 UTC (we saw 504), 2) our fallback returned 'name_mismatch' instead of 'timeout' which caused auto-flag rule to fire. Log snippet: ```[2026-03-15T09:18:12Z] VIES 504, fallback -> parsed: {"status":"name_mismatch"}```

lukas: Good catch. I'll have infra add clearer error mapping so 'timeout' doesn't masquerade as 'name_mismatch'. That should reduce false positives.

maria: In the meantime, we can manually clear if vendor provides the docs. Jordan, mark as 'awaiting vendor docs' and please paste docs link here when available.

jordan: Marked and pinged vendor. I'll post the uploaded PDFs here once received. Thanks all :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Reminder queued: if docs are not uploaded within 5 business days, invoice will remain on hold and customer will get a follow-up.

maria: Also noting billing policy: if the vendor cannot provide evidence, finance will invoice gross with VAT and charge to customer; reversal requires retro docs and may need credit note.

jordan: Understood. I'll push vendor for expedited docs and update this thread.

(compliance-eng added a short template): ```We need: (1) Resale certificate PDF with VAT ID, (2) Signed letter on company letterhead confirming legal entity and VAT ID, (3) PO amendment or authorization from buyer.```

maria: Thanks — closing interim until docs arrive. Feel free to re-open with attachments.
